class Stop(Exception): pass

    for _ in range(3):
        try: w=real(system,text)

        if w: seen[k]=w; return w

stopped=0

with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(14) as p: list(p.map(one,rows))
json.dump(seen,open(C,'w'))
print('rows',len(rows),'calls',len(seen),'stopped',stopped)
if not stopped:
